correctness.rationale: For L>0, 0<ρ<1, a mod L, the exact Fock monomial eigenvalue is gamma expectation λ_n=(1/n!)∫_0^∞g(u)e^{-u}u^n du. Fourier mask coefficients c_m=[sin(πmρ)/(πm)]exp[−im(πρ+2πa/L)] and gamma transform q_m=(1−2πim/L)^−1 imply absolutely convergent λ_n−ρ=Σ_{m≠0}c_m q_m^{n+1}, with error O(r₂^{n+1}) after m=±1. Two-conjugate geometric terms produce exact Hankel H_n=−4|b|²r^{2n+4}sin²θ[1+O((r₂/r)^n)]; since b≠0, sinθ>0, it is eventually negative. The H ratio tends r², yielding L=2π/sqrt(R^−1−1), and two successive calibrated deviations recover complex b then a modulo L. Valid for all L and interior duty ρ, not noisy spectra or ρ=0,1. Independent high-precision Fourier-gamma recreation at L=1.7,ρ=.31,a=.72 recovered L to 3.22e−11 at n≈32, H<0. The frozen checker.py was inspected; its finite assertions are not the proof.
